turns.doctor_question: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response:
Hi, Dr. Smith. Well, I guess what brings me in is that I just can't seem to keep my mind on one thing anymore. 

I work in a warehouse, and lately, every little thing catches my attention. Like, a beeper will go off, or I'll hear a forklift alarm, or someone is just moving a pallet nearby... and it completely pulls me off my count. Then I look down and realize I've gone and put the wrong numbers into the inventory system. It's just getting to be a real problem at work.
